alternative_approach: FDA Nozzle Benchmark — published experimental measurements that svFSI itself is validated against.

reference.name: FDA Nozzle Benchmark
reference.citation: FDA Critical Path Initiative. 'Interlaboratory Standardization of the Nozzle Benchmark'. ASME V&V 40.
reference.geometry: Converging-diverging nozzle, inlet diameter 30mm, throat diameter 12mm, outlet diameter 20mm
reference.published_measurements: Pressure drop vs flow rate, measured at multiple axial positions
reference.why_relevant: This is the standard hemodynamic solver verification case. svFSI publishes validation against this benchmark. If our hydraulic model agrees with the published measurements on a simplified version of this geometry, the physics is validated.

simplified_geometry.description: Simplified to 1D hydraulic model (matches P-01's multi-segment abstraction). Nozzle modeled as 3 segments: inlet, throat, outlet.

frozen_criterion.published_value_range: 8-15 mmHg at 5 L/min (from FDA benchmark data)
frozen_criterion.pass_condition: Our model predicts pressure drop within 25% of published range
